retained_foundations: B8.10hbe gives the positive radial realization for the actual compact arrays on every residual group, together with their signed wave and mixed lift identities. The root-sheet expansion, coordinate normalizations and terminal isometry are used at the same Haar scales.

The original interlacing products, critical-level mass bound, representation-density majorants and whole-row absolute convergence enter on the selected arithmetic family. The level-zero scalar model uses its adjoint, transfer and integrability estimates.

The derivation treats the scalar contribution to two different words. Equal words, deficient orbits and the conversion from scalar energy to a Hilbert–Schmidt bound use the separate calculations in the period chapter.

formal_consumer.scope: The original row theorem applies the density-normalized recursion and row data. The realization of the actual signed coefficients and their local identities is a prerequisite to this application.
